reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 14.8 (p0182) addresses only each party's supervision/assignment of its own personnel and subcontracting, and § 14.16 (p0200) confirms freedom to contract with others — neither imposes a non-solicit, no-hire or anti-recruitment covenant on Customer.

Absence of any non-solicit matches the rule's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so this is correctly treated as compliant rather than missing; the absence benefits our party and must not be flagged.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed — the rendered text is identical to the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because there is no non-solicit clause for those heuristics to measure; they do not undercut the compliance conclusion.
